records.text: Candace Owens recalled that Charlie Kirk’s rule was never to decline Fox News, even for a 4 a.m. appearance, and that they sometimes did four Fox hits in one day
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: We had a bunch of rules. Charlie (Charlie Kirk)'s rule was never say no to Fox News. So even if the show was at 4 a.m. in the morning, crack of dawn, I cannot tell you guys how many hits we did on Fox News. I'm talking four hits a day, up at 4 a.m. for Fox & Friends First and then doing whatever the evening program was, because he believed this is the way that we're going to get our names out there.

verification.notes: Verified as a first-person attribution claim from Owens’s primary memorial recording. She states Kirk’s rule was never to decline Fox News, gives the 4 a.m. example, and says they did four hits in a day. The verification establishes her documented firsthand account; it does not infer that four appearances occurred every day.
